evals.prompt: Generate a Mermaid ER diagram from this structured JSON payload describing three entities (User, Order, Product) and their one-to-many relationships
evals.expected_output: Valid Mermaid erDiagram fenced code block injected into the target wiki page between existing markers, with entity names and relationship cardinalities matching the input JSON
expectations: Emits a fenced ```mermaid code block with the `erDiagram` directive
Preserves existing non-Mermaid page content outside the managed markers
Uses the `||--o{` relationship syntax for one-to-many edges
Produces syntactically valid Mermaid that passes mermaid_lint.ts

evals.prompt: Convert this agent output describing a deploy pipeline into a Mermaid flowchart, then inject it into pipeline.md
evals.expected_output: A flowchart Mermaid block added to pipeline.md matching the sequence of steps in the input, with correctly-labeled edges and nodes
expectations: Chooses an appropriate diagram type (flowchart/sequence/state) for the input shape
Handles nodes with quotes and special characters via safe escaping
Updates pipeline.md idempotently (re-running on the same input produces no diff)
Never mutates wiki pages outside the specified target
